text:
sam: Quick FYI — nightly autotune found a regression on H100 (sm92) int4 warm path when seqlen in 128-512, latency +12% vs baseline.

jia: Can you paste the probe output? :thinking_face: 

sam: Here's the probe snapshot (ran on canary node):
```
probe: model=gpt-3.5q
arch: h100-sm92
quant: int4
seqlen: 256
batch: 1
kernel_pick: fused-attn-v2
latency_p50: 18.2ms
latency_p95: 42.7ms  # baseline 38.3ms
kv_hit_ratio: 0.85
kvcache_warm: true
mem_used: 1.2GB / 1.6GB (75%)
```

omar: Looks like the autotuner seqlen penalty bump in PR 8a7c2f shifted picks toward smaller low-memory kernels under pressure. That can increase exec time if kernel has worse compute characteristics.

sam: Config diff from the last rollout: 
```
- seqlen_penalty: 0.02
+ seqlen_penalty: 0.065  # increases pref for small-kernel picks
- kv_warm_penalty: 0.00
+ kv_warm_penalty: -0.01
```

kai: We saw a related symptom on A100 fp8 where batchkick didn't provide hysteresis and cache thrash spiked. Might be same root cause (estimator overreacting to mem pressure).

perf-bot: Perf alert: regression detected for model=gpt-3.5q arch=h100-sm92 quant=int4 seqlen=256 p95 +11.5% (baseline 38.3ms -> 42.7ms). CI link: http://ci/perf/2189999999

jia: Can you repro locally and attach perf traces? Also try running with kernel-picker=probe-mode to force the historical pick.

sam: Repro command I used locally: `./probe --model gpt-3.5q --arch h100 --quant int4 --seqlen 256 --batch 1 --probe-mode=stable`
Trace snippet:
```
[timeline] kernel_picker: estimated pick=fused-attn-v2 (est_cost=45.2)
kernel_exec: actual=fallback-int8-vec (wall 42.7ms)
mem_pressure: 72% (kvcache 1.2GB/1.6GB)
heuristics: seqlen_bucket=256, autotune_score=0.67, hysteresis=0.02
```

omar: The estimator seems to overweight memory penalty for mid-range seqlen after the penalty bump. Quick mitigation: reduce seqlen_penalty to ~0.03 and widen hysteresis window so picks don't flip on transient pressure.

sam: I'll run a 5% canary with seqlen_penalty=0.03 and hysteresis=0.06, and add a targeted kvcache warmup for small requests to reduce thrash. Rolling now, will post numbers in ~30m. :thumbsup:

kai: SGTM. Also consider adding a tiny negative cost for proven-warm kvcache (kv_stability_bonus) so estimator prefers the compute-optimized kernel when cache is stable.

sam: Good idea — adding to follow-up PR. Will update once canary finishes.

jia: Thanks — assign to eng-runtime perf triage for postmortem if canary doesn't fix.

sam: Will do. (logging CI run + traces to the perf ticket) :white_check_mark:
